items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: You played the John Philip Sousa and so forth? ... Oh yes. I was a favorite trumpet player among the marching bands in those days because I could remember those tunes note for note

ctx.x: Yes, it was a little different. New Orleans was mostly jazz.
You played the John Philip Sousa and so forth?

Oh yes. I was a favorite trumpet player among the marching bands in those days because I could remember those tunes note for note and I didn't have to be walking down the street trying to read as I was playing.
